description: This file defines template classes for internal btree container implementations, including btree_set, btree_map, and their multiset/multimap variants, with methods for insertion, deletion, lookup, and merging.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::btree_container
classes.description: Base class template for btree-based containers like set, map, multiset, multimap.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::btree_set_container
classes.description: Derived class template for set-like containers based on btree.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::btree_map_container
classes.description: Derived class template for map-like containers based on btree.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::btree_multiset_container
classes.description: Derived class template for multiset-like containers based on btree.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::btree_multimap_container
classes.description: Derived class template for multimap-like containers based on btree.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of container.

methods.name: merge
